FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Biopharma_Perfusion_TFF_Harvest
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* LUMINA ADVANCED PROCESS AUTOMATION & CYBER-PHYSICAL CONTROL SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE               *)
(* DOMAIN: Biopharmaceutical Continuous Perfusion Bioreactor: TFF Harvest & Biomass Retention     *)
(* SYSTEM SPECIFICATION: Tangential Flow Hollow-Fiber Filtration with Micro-Capacitance VCD       *)
(* ALGORITHMS & IMPLEMENTATION FEATURES:                                                          *)
(*   1. 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) Sensor Voting with Mid-Value Selection (MVS)           *)
(*   2. Temperature-Compensated Normalized Transmembrane Pressure (TMP_norm @ 20 deg C)            *)
(*   3. Darcy-Starling Dynamic Hydraulic Resistance & Cake Gel Layer Growth Modeling (Rm + Rc)   *)
(*   4. Discrete 2x2 MIMO State-Space Model Predictive Control (MPC) with Anti-Windup Clamping    *)
(*   5. Multi-Tiered ISA-18.2 Compliant Deterministic Alarm Hierarchy & Status Bitmasks           *)
(*   6. Graceful Failover, Reversible Backpulse Cycle, and Multi-Stage Asynchronous State Engine  *)
(* COMPLIANCE: IEC 61131-3 3rd Edition, cGMP GAMP-5 Category 4, ANSI/ISA-88 Batch/Continuous      *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)

VAR_INPUT
    bEnable                 : BOOL;     (* Master execution enable supervisory permissive *)
    bEmergencyStop          : BOOL;     (* Safety loop interlock healthy [Active HIGH, TRUE=OK] *)
    bAcknowledgeFaults      : BOOL;     (* Operator fault reset and latch clear pulse *)
    rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA       : REAL;     (* TFF Module Inlet Pressure Channel A [bar] *)
    rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB       : REAL;     (* TFF Module Inlet Pressure Channel B [bar] *)
    rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC       : REAL;     (* TFF Module Inlet Pressure Channel C [bar] *)
    rP_Retentate            : REAL;     (* TFF Retentate Return Header Backpressure [bar] *)
    rP_Permeate             : REAL;     (* TFF Permeate/Filtrate Header Pressure [mbar] *)
    rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1    : REAL;     (* Primary In-situ Radio-Frequency Permittivity Probe [cells/mL] *)
    rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2    : REAL;     (* Redundant Optical Turbidity/Dielectric Biomass Probe [cells/mL] *)
    rVCD_Setpoint           : REAL;     (* Continuous Perfusion Target Viable Cell Density [cells/mL] *)
    rHarvestFlow_PV         : REAL;     (* Actual Harvest/Permeate Volumetric Flowmeter [L/h] *)
    rBioreactorTemp         : REAL;     (* Live Bioreactor Broth Process Temperature [deg C] *)
    rFilterSurfaceArea      : REAL;     (* Total Installed Hollow Fiber Membrane Area [m2] *)
    rTargetFlux_LMH         : REAL;     (* Target Permeate Specific Flux [LMH = L/(m2*h)] *)
    rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar     : REAL;     (* Critical Maximum Safe TMP Tripping Threshold [mbar] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady            : BOOL;     (* Harvesting skid validated and within operational bounds *)
    bInterlockActive        : BOOL;     (* Critical safety interlock currently tripped *)
    bDegradedMode           : BOOL;     (* Process operating under degraded sensor/actuator redundancy *)
    rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd      : REAL;     (* Recirculation/Shear Feed Pump VFD Demand [0.0 .. 100.0 %] *)
    rHarvestPump_Cmd        : REAL;     (* Permeate Extraction Metering Pump Setpoint [L/h] *)
    rBleedPump_Cmd          : REAL;     (* Cell Bleed Rate to Maintain Biomass Setpoint [L/h] *)
    rCalculated_TMP         : REAL;     (* Normalized Transmembrane Pressure (20 deg C ref) [mbar] *)
    rCalculated_Flux        : REAL;     (* Normalized Real-time Permeate Flux [LMH = L/(m2*h)] *)
    rMembraneResistance     : REAL;     (* Estimated Total Hydraulic Resistance (Rm + Rc) [1/m] *)
    wAlarmWord              : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 Diagnostic Alarm Bitmask (Bits 0-15) *)
    wStatusWord             : WORD;     (* Subsystem Operational State Bitmask (Bits 0-15) *)
    iCurrentStateCode       : INT;      (* Active Finite State Machine Index [0..90] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    (* INTERNAL 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) REGISTERS                                   *)
    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    bFeedChA_Healthy        : BOOL;     (* Channel A within realistic electrical/hydraulic boundaries *)
    bFeedChB_Healthy        : BOOL;     (* Channel B within realistic electrical/hydraulic boundaries *)
    bFeedChC_Healthy        : BOOL;     (* Channel C within realistic electrical/hydraulic boundaries *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount  : INT;      (* Tally of operational feed pressure channels [0..3] *)
    rChA_ChB_Delta          : REAL;     (* Inter-channel absolute discrepancy |A - B| [bar] *)
    rChB_ChC_Delta          : REAL;     (* Inter-channel absolute discrepancy |B - C| [bar] *)
    rChC_ChA_Delta          : REAL;     (* Inter-channel absolute discrepancy |C - A| [bar] *)
    rFeedPressure_Voted     : REAL;     (* Voted output feed pressure [bar] *)
    rMaxSensorDeviation_bar : REAL := 0.150; (* Permissible TMR inter-channel tolerance [bar] *)

    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    (* BIOMASS VIABLE CELL DENSITY (VCD) DUAL SENSOR VALIDATION                                   *)
    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    rVCD_Active_PV          : REAL;     (* Cross-checked consensus Viable Cell Density [cells/mL] *)
    rVCD_SensorDeviation    : REAL;     (* Relative divergence between probe 1 and probe 2 [%] *)
    bVCD_DualProbeMismatch  : BOOL;     (* Drift detection flag between independent probe technologies *)

    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    (* HYDRODYNAMICS, VISCOSITY & FOULING ACCUMULATORS                                           *)
    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    rDynamicViscosity_Pa_s  : REAL;     (* Water/Broth temperature-dependent dynamic viscosity [Pa*s] *)
    rViscosityCorrectionFact: REAL;     (* Correction scalar normalized to 20.0 deg C baseline *)
    rP_Retentate_mbar       : REAL;     (* Converted retentate pressure [mbar] *)
    rP_Feed_mbar            : REAL;     (* Converted feed inlet pressure [mbar] *)
    rRaw_TMP_mbar           : REAL;     (* Uncompensated instantaneous Transmembrane Pressure [mbar] *)
    rDeltaP_Axial_bar       : REAL;     (* Axial lumen pressure drop: P_feed - P_retentate [bar] *)
    rLast_TMP_Sample        : REAL;     (* Memory register for numerical rate-of-rise derivation [mbar] *)
    rTMP_RateOfRise_mbar_min: REAL;     (* First derivative d(TMP)/dt calculated over sample window *)
    tRateDerivTimer         : TON;      (* Periodic 10.0-second derivative evaluation timer *)

    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    (* DISCRETE 2x2 MIMO MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROLLER (MPC) MATRICES & REGISTERS                   *)
    (* Controlled Vector:   Y = [ TMP_mbar, VCD_10e6_mL ]^T                                      *)
    (* Manipulated Vector:  U = [ HarvestFlow_L_h, BleedFlow_L_h ]^T                             *)
    (* Discrete State Space Form: X(k+1) = A*X(k) + B*U(k), Y(k) = C*X(k)                        *)
    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    (* State-space transition matrix A_d (Sampling time Ts = 1.0s, cell doubling & membrane model)*)
    A_11                    : REAL := 0.9620; (* TMP self-decay and polarization retention *)
    A_12                    : REAL := 0.0045; (* Cross-coupling: VCD increase accelerates cake fouling *)
    A_21                    : REAL := 0.0000; (* Pressure impact on cell replication (assumed negligible) *)
    A_22                    : REAL := 0.9982; (* Specific cell growth dynamic parameter *)

    (* Input distribution matrix B_d *)
    B_11                    : REAL := 0.3850; (* Harvest flux amplification on TMP *)
    B_12                    : REAL := -0.0210;(* Bleed flow relief on cake accumulation *)
    B_21                    : REAL := -0.0012;(* Dilution loss via harvest filtrate (retention efficiency) *)
    B_22                    : REAL := -0.1550;(* Direct biomass dilution via cell bleed line *)

    (* Internal MPC tracking registers *)
    rInternalState_X1       : REAL := 0.0; (* State variable 1: Normalized TMP estimate *)
    rInternalState_X2       : REAL := 0.0; (* State variable 2: Viable cell biomass estimate *)
    rPredicted_Y1           : REAL := 0.0; (* One-step-ahead predicted TMP *)
    rPredicted_Y2           : REAL := 0.0; (* One-step-ahead predicted VCD *)
    rError_TMP              : REAL := 0.0; (* Regulation tracking error: TMP_target - TMP_actual *)
    rError_VCD              : REAL := 0.0; (* Regulation tracking error: VCD_setpoint - VCD_actual *)

    (* Decoupled MPC Steady-State Gains & Tuning Weights *)
    rGain_P11_Harvest_TMP   : REAL := 0.125;  (* Feedforward/feedback gain for TMP regulation *)
    rGain_P22_Bleed_VCD     : REAL := 0.085;  (* Feedback gain for cell density bleed regulation *)
    rGain_Decouple_Bleed_TMP: REAL := -0.015; (* Decoupling matrix element to minimize TMP transient *)
    rIntegral_TMP_Error     : REAL := 0.0;    (* Integral accumulator for zero steady-state error *)
    rIntegral_VCD_Error     : REAL := 0.0;    (* Integral accumulator for biomass retention *)
    rHarvest_Min_Clamp_L_h  : REAL := 0.50;   (* Minimum viable perfusion harvest throughput [L/h] *)
    rHarvest_Max_Clamp_L_h  : REAL := 25.00;  (* Maximum hydraulic capacity of hollow fiber skid [L/h] *)
    rBleed_Max_Clamp_L_h    : REAL := 5.00;   (* Maximum allowable bleed rate to prevent vessel dry-out *)

    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    (* FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) TIMERS & SEQUENCING REGISTERS                                  *)
    (* ========================================================================================== *)
    iState                  : INT := 0; (* Active sequencer state pointer *)
    iPreviousState          : INT := 0; (* Historical state register for transition diagnostics *)
    tStateTimer             : TON;      (* Universal dwell, timeout, and watchdog timer *)
    tBackpulseTimer         : TON;      (* Precise duration control for permeate reverse pulse *)
    tShearFlushTimer        : TON;      (* Duration control for high-recirculation scouring cycle *)
    bBackpulseTrigger       : BOOL;     (* Internal request to execute membrane declogging cycle *)
    iFoulingCycleCounter    : INT := 0; (* Totalized count of membrane regeneration cycles performed *)
    rBackpulseDuration_s    : REAL := 12.0; (* Pulse time for reverse permeate dislodgement [s] *)
    rShearFlushDuration_s   : REAL := 45.0; (* Flush duration for axial crossflow shear sweep [s] *)
END_VAR

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 1: SAFETY INTERLOCK & HARDWARE INTEGRITY EVALUATION                                    *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Immediate Safe-State Actuator Shutdown *)
    rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 0.0;
    rHarvestPump_Cmd    := 0.0;
    rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.0;
    bSystemReady        := FALSE;
    bInterlockActive    := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord          := wAlarmWord OR 16#2000; (* Bit 13: Emergency Stop Loop Tripped *)
    iState              := 90; (* Jump straight to Emergency Safe Hold *)
    iCurrentStateCode   := iState;
    RETURN;
ELSE
    bInterlockActive    := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord          := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#2000;
END_IF;

IF bAcknowledgeFaults THEN
    (* Reset latching non-critical warning bits *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND 16#2000; (* Retain active E-Stop status only *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING LOGIC                           *)
(* Validates three redundant feed pressure transmitters; isolates drifting/failed channels        *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* Boundary Sanity Checks [0.0 .. 4.5 bar] *)
bFeedChA_Healthy := (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA >= 0.0) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA <= 4.5);
bFeedChB_Healthy := (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB >= 0.0) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB <= 4.5);
bFeedChC_Healthy := (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC >= 0.0) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC <= 4.5);

(* Inter-Channel Deviation Calculations *)
rChA_ChB_Delta := ABS(rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA - rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB);
rChB_ChC_Delta := ABS(rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB - rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC);
rChC_ChA_Delta := ABS(rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC - rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA);

(* Individual Channel Discrepancy Diagnostics *)
IF bFeedChA_Healthy AND bFeedChB_Healthy AND bFeedChC_Healthy THEN
    (* 3-Channel Healthy: Perform Mid-Value Selection (MVS) *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 3;
    bDegradedMode          := FALSE;

    (* Identify individual sensor drift beyond permissible tolerance *)
    IF (rChA_ChB_Delta > rMaxSensorDeviation_bar) AND (rChC_ChA_Delta > rMaxSensorDeviation_bar) THEN
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Channel A Discrepant *)
    ELSE
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0010;
    END_IF;

    IF (rChA_ChB_Delta > rMaxSensorDeviation_bar) AND (rChB_ChC_Delta > rMaxSensorDeviation_bar) THEN
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Channel B Discrepant *)
    ELSE
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0020;
    END_IF;

    IF (rChB_ChC_Delta > rMaxSensorDeviation_bar) AND (rChC_ChA_Delta > rMaxSensorDeviation_bar) THEN
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Channel C Discrepant *)
    ELSE
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0040;
    END_IF;

    (* Standard Median Voter Logic *)
    IF ((rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA >= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA <= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC)) OR
       ((rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA <= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA >= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC)) THEN
        rFeedPressure_Voted := rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB >= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB <= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC)) OR
          ((rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB <= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA) AND (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB >= rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC)) THEN
        rFeedPressure_Voted := rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB;
    ELSE
        rFeedPressure_Voted := rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC;
    END_IF;

ELSIF (bFeedChA_Healthy AND bFeedChB_Healthy) THEN
    (* 2oo2 Degraded Mode: Average A & B *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 2;
    bDegradedMode          := TRUE;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA + rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord             := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040; (* Flag C as failed *)

ELSIF (bFeedChB_Healthy AND bFeedChC_Healthy) THEN
    (* 2oo2 Degraded Mode: Average B & C *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 2;
    bDegradedMode          := TRUE;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB + rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord             := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Flag A as failed *)

ELSIF (bFeedChA_Healthy AND bFeedChC_Healthy) THEN
    (* 2oo2 Degraded Mode: Average A & C *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 2;
    bDegradedMode          := TRUE;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := (rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA + rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC) * 0.5;
    wAlarmWord             := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020; (* Flag B as failed *)

ELSIF bFeedChA_Healthy THEN
    (* 1oo1 Highly Degraded Mode: Simplex fallback *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 1;
    bDegradedMode          := TRUE;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := rP_Feed_Inlet_ChA;

ELSIF bFeedChB_Healthy THEN
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 1;
    bDegradedMode          := TRUE;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := rP_Feed_Inlet_ChB;

ELSIF bFeedChC_Healthy THEN
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 1;
    bDegradedMode          := TRUE;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := rP_Feed_Inlet_ChC;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Blackout: All 3 channels failed *)
    iValidFeedSensorsCount := 0;
    rFeedPressure_Voted    := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord             := wAlarmWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Complete TMR Sensor Loss *)
    iState                 := 90; (* Trip to Safe Hold *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 3: VCD DUAL-TRANSMITTER CONCORDANCE & DIVERGENCE CHECK                                 *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
IF (rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1 > 1.0E4) AND (rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2 > 1.0E4) THEN
    rVCD_SensorDeviation := ABS(rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1 - rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2) / 
                            ((rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1 + rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2) * 0.5);
    IF rVCD_SensorDeviation > 0.150 THEN (* Exceeds 15% discrepancy threshold *)
        bVCD_DualProbeMismatch := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord             := wAlarmWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Biomass Sensor Drift *)
        rVCD_Active_PV         := MIN(rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1, rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2); (* Conservative *)
    ELSE
        bVCD_DualProbeMismatch := FALSE;
        wAlarmWord             := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0100;
        rVCD_Active_PV         := (rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1 + rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Fallback to whichever sensor is transmitting positive non-zero telemetry *)
    rVCD_Active_PV := MAX(rVCD_Biomass_Sensor1, rVCD_Biomass_Sensor2);
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 4: TEMPERATURE COMPENSATION, TMP CALCULATION & DARCY HYDRAULIC RESISTANCE              *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* Dynamic Viscosity Compensation for Culture Broth (20 deg C reference)                         *)
(* Polynomial fit for aqueous media: mu(T) in [mPa*s] -> [Pa*s]                                  *)
IF (rBioreactorTemp >= 32.0) AND (rBioreactorTemp <= 42.0) THEN
    rDynamicViscosity_Pa_s := (1.002 * (1.0 - 0.0245 * (rBioreactorTemp - 20.0) + 
                              0.00035 * (rBioreactorTemp - 20.0) * (rBioreactorTemp - 20.0))) * 0.001;
    rViscosityCorrectionFact := 0.001002 / MAX(rDynamicViscosity_Pa_s, 0.0004);
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0200; (* Clear Temperature Out-of-Spec Bit 9 *)
ELSE
    rViscosityCorrectionFact := 1.0; (* Failsafe unity scaling *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Temperature Out of Range *)
END_IF;

(* Pressure Unit Normalization and Calculations *)
rP_Feed_mbar      := rFeedPressure_Voted * 1000.0;
rP_Retentate_mbar := rP_Retentate * 1000.0;
rDeltaP_Axial_bar := rFeedPressure_Voted - rP_Retentate;

(* Classical Transmembrane Pressure (TMP) Formula *)
rRaw_TMP_mbar := ((rP_Feed_mbar + rP_Retentate_mbar) * 0.5) - rP_Permeate;

(* Temperature-Normalized TMP for Fouling Evaluation *)
rCalculated_TMP := rRaw_TMP_mbar * rViscosityCorrectionFact;

(* Specific Permeate Flux Calculation [LMH = L/(m2*h)] *)
IF rFilterSurfaceArea > 0.01 THEN
    rCalculated_Flux := rHarvestFlow_PV / rFilterSurfaceArea;
ELSE
    rCalculated_Flux := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Total Darcy Hydraulic Membrane Resistance (Rm + Rc) = TMP [Pa] / (mu [Pa*s] * J [m/s]) *)
(* Conversion: 1 mbar = 100 Pa; 1 LMH = (1 / 3.6E6) m/s                                   *)
IF (rCalculated_Flux > 0.1) AND (rDynamicViscosity_Pa_s > 0.0001) THEN
    rMembraneResistance := (rRaw_TMP_mbar * 100.0) / 
                           (rDynamicViscosity_Pa_s * (rCalculated_Flux / 3600000.0));
ELSE
    rMembraneResistance := 1.0E11; (* Baseline clean membrane nominal value *)
END_IF;

(* Rate-of-Rise (d(TMP)/dt) Evaluation for Cake Polarization Diagnostics *)
tRateDerivTimer(IN := NOT tRateDerivTimer.Q, PT := T#10S);
IF tRateDerivTimer.Q THEN
    rTMP_RateOfRise_mbar_min := (rCalculated_TMP - rLast_TMP_Sample) * 6.0; (* Extrapolated to 60s *)
    rLast_TMP_Sample         := rCalculated_TMP;

    IF rTMP_RateOfRise_mbar_min > 18.0 THEN
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Rapid Membrane Fouling Rate *)
        bBackpulseTrigger := TRUE; (* Request regenerative shear flush *)
    ELSE
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0008;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Comprehensive Pressure Limit Alarms *)
IF rCalculated_TMP >= rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Critical High TMP *)
ELSIF rCalculated_TMP >= (rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar * 0.82) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: High TMP Warning *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0003;
END_IF;

IF rDeltaP_Axial_bar >= 0.750 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: High Axial Lumen Delta-P *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0004;
END_IF;

IF rMembraneResistance > 1.8E12 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000; (* Bit 12: Critical Hydraulic Resistance *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND NOT 16#1000;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================== *)
(* SECTION 5: MULTI-STAGE CYBER-PHYSICAL STATE MACHINE                                           *)
(* ============================================================================================== *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#3600S);
iPreviousState := iState;
iCurrentStateCode := iState;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_IDLE_STANDBY: Unit offline awaiting supervisory enable command *)
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := 0.0;
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.0;
        rIntegral_TMP_Error := 0.0;
        rIntegral_VCD_Error := 0.0;
        wStatusWord         := 16#0001;

        IF bEnable AND (wAlarmWord = 0) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Pre-Flush & NWP Integrity Verification *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_PRE_FLUSH_INTEGRITY: Verify Clean Water Permeability & Baseline Baseline *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#0002;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 35.0; (* Moderate laminar crossflow [35%] *)
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := 2.5;  (* Initial tare permeate draw [2.5 L/h] *)
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.0;

        IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#30S THEN
            IF (rCalculated_TMP > 30.0) AND (rCalculated_TMP < 220.0) THEN
                rBaselineCleanWaterTMP := rCalculated_TMP;
                iState := 20; (* Baseline validated; proceed to Broth Equilibration *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Membrane fouling or seal breach *)
                iState := 90;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_RECIRCULATION_EQUILIBRATION: Ramp crossflow shear rate to suspend biomass *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#0004;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 65.0; (* Full crossflow velocity to create wall shear rate *)
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := 0.0;  (* Retain all fluid, permeate closed *)
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.0;

        IF (tStateTimer.ET >= T#20S) AND (rDeltaP_Axial_bar < 0.40) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            iState := 30; (* Stable shear boundary formed; advance to continuous harvest *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_PERFUSION_STEADY_STATE_MPC: Closed-loop 2x2 MIMO Model Predictive Control *)
        wStatusWord  := 16#0008;
        bSystemReady := TRUE;

        (* 1. Maintain crossflow recirculation pump proportional to biomass load *)
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd := 50.0 + ((rVCD_Active_PV / 1.0E8) * 35.0);
        IF rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd > 95.0 THEN
            rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd := 95.0;
        END_IF;

        (* 2. Discrete State-Space Prediction & Error Evaluation *)
        rError_TMP := (rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar * 0.70) - rCalculated_TMP;
        rError_VCD := rVCD_Active_PV - rVCD_Setpoint;

        (* Anti-windup conditional integration *)
        IF (rHarvestPump_Cmd > rHarvest_Min_Clamp_L_h) AND (rHarvestPump_Cmd < rHarvest_Max_Clamp_L_h) THEN
            rIntegral_TMP_Error := rIntegral_TMP_Error + (rError_TMP * 0.005);
        END_IF;
        IF (rBleedPump_Cmd > 0.0) AND (rBleedPump_Cmd < rBleed_Max_Clamp_L_h) THEN
            rIntegral_VCD_Error := rIntegral_VCD_Error + ((rError_VCD / 1.0E7) * 0.008);
        END_IF;

        (* State Predictor Update (Observer step) *)
        rPredicted_Y1 := (A_11 * rCalculated_TMP) + (B_11 * rHarvestPump_Cmd);
        rPredicted_Y2 := (A_22 * (rVCD_Active_PV / 1.0E6)) + (B_22 * rBleedPump_Cmd);

        (* MPC Multi-Variable Control Actuation Calculations *)
        (* Harvest calculation prioritizes target flux while backing off if TMP spikes *)
        rHarvestPump_Cmd := (rTargetFlux_LMH * rFilterSurfaceArea) + 
                            (rGain_P11_Harvest_TMP * rError_TMP) + 
                            rIntegral_TMP_Error;

        (* Bleed calculation controls biomass concentration while accounting for harvest impact *)
        rBleedPump_Cmd   := ((rError_VCD / 1.0E7) * rGain_P22_Bleed_VCD) + 
                            (rGain_Decouple_Bleed_TMP * rError_TMP) + 
                            rIntegral_VCD_Error;

        (* Clamping & Saturation Limits *)
        IF rHarvestPump_Cmd < rHarvest_Min_Clamp_L_h THEN
            rHarvestPump_Cmd := rHarvest_Min_Clamp_L_h;
        ELSIF rHarvestPump_Cmd > rHarvest_Max_Clamp_L_h THEN
            rHarvestPump_Cmd := rHarvest_Max_Clamp_L_h;
        END_IF;

        IF rBleedPump_Cmd < 0.0 THEN
            rBleedPump_Cmd := 0.0;
        ELSIF rBleedPump_Cmd > rBleed_Max_Clamp_L_h THEN
            rBleedPump_Cmd := rBleed_Max_Clamp_L_h;
        END_IF;

        (* State Transitions & Disturbance Interventions *)
        IF (rCalculated_TMP > (rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar * 0.88)) OR bBackpulseTrigger THEN
            iState := 40; (* High concentration polarization; trigger Hydrodynamic Shear Flush *)
        ELSIF bDegradedMode THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Degraded Rate-Limiting Mode *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_ACTIVE_SHEAR_FLUSH: High axial crossflow burst to scour membrane surface *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#0010;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 98.0; (* Maximum axial velocity to generate high wall shear stress *)
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := 0.5;  (* Throttle permeate extraction to zero gradient *)
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.2;

        tShearFlushTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        IF tShearFlushTimer.Q THEN
            tShearFlushTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bBackpulseTrigger := FALSE;
            IF rCalculated_TMP > (rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar * 0.85) THEN
                iState := 60; (* Scouring insufficient; initiate Permeate Reverse Backpulse *)
            ELSE
                iState := 30; (* Cake layer dislodged; resume MPC perfusion *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_AUTOMATED_CELL_BLEED: Dedicated high-rate biomass purging sequence *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#0020;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 60.0;
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := rHarvest_Min_Clamp_L_h;
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := rBleed_Max_Clamp_L_h; (* Maximum allowable cell purge *)

        IF rVCD_Active_PV <= (rVCD_Setpoint * 1.02) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Cell density returned to controlled window *)
        ELSIF tStateTimer.ET >= T#1800S THEN
            wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: Bleed Line Flow Ineffectiveness *)
            iState := 30; (* Escape timeout *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_REVERSE_BACKPULSE: Physical permeate reversal to dislodge pore plugging *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#0040;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 40.0;
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := -2.0; (* Negative flow command: Reverse metering pump injection *)
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.0;
        iFoulingCycleCounter:= iFoulingCycleCounter + 1;

        tBackpulseTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#12S);
        IF tBackpulseTimer.Q THEN
            tBackpulseTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rHarvestPump_Cmd := 0.0;
            IF iFoulingCycleCounter > 8 THEN
                wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000; (* Bit 12: Membrane Life Depleted / Irreversible *)
                iState := 80; (* Force degraded operation *)
            ELSE
                iState := 20; (* Re-equilibrate and resume *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_DEGRADED_GRACEFUL_OPERATION: Reduced throughput under sensor/actuator failover *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#0080;
        bSystemReady        := TRUE;
        bDegradedMode       := TRUE;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 60.0;
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := MIN(rHarvestPump_Cmd, 6.0); (* Strict throughput derating [6.0 L/h] *)
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.5;

        (* Hold conservative parameters; monitor for further decay *)
        IF (iValidFeedSensorsCount = 0) OR (rCalculated_TMP >= rMaxAllowedTMP_mbar) THEN
            iState := 90; (* Unrecoverable cascade failure; emergency stop *)
        ELSIF (NOT bDegradedMode) AND (wAlarmWord = 0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Redundancy restored; return to optimal MPC *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_HOLD: Controlled hydraulic isolation and shutdown *)
        wStatusWord         := 16#8000;
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_Cmd  := 0.0;
        rHarvestPump_Cmd    := 0.0;
        rBleedPump_Cmd      := 0.0;
        rIntegral_TMP_Error := 0.0;
        rIntegral_VCD_Error := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND (wAlarmWord = 0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Manual operator acknowledge and restart *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
